name: Microgrid resource-role assignment
summary: Assigns the selected resources to their documented grid-forming or following control roles.
description: Assigns the selected resources to their documented grid-forming or following control roles. A microgrid operating-mode function coordinates how local sources and loads relate to the utility connection. The selected mode, the measured electrical condition and the actual switching configuration can differ during a transition.

In a microgrid serving a switchroom and industrial loads, the controller can move between grid-connected and islanded operating states only through its defined transition logic. Each state needs identifiable source roles and feedback. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Resource capability and topology” at the input and “Assigned resource roles” at the output. The controller cannot create unsupported equipment capability.
